verses.1: And in the fourth year of Darius’ reign, there was a message from Jehovah to Zekaria. This happened on the ninth day of the fifth month.
verses.2: And the Temple of God sent its treasurer and his men to offer sacrifices on the face of Jehovah.
verses.3: And he said to the priests who were in the house of God, “In the fifth month, on the day of atonement, remember that I have done this as well. It’s like what was done in previous years.”
verses.4: And the words of Jehovah came to me in visions.
verses.5: Say to all the people of the land and to the priests, “For you have sinned and rebelled on the fifth and seventh days. This is the seventy years during which I have been suffering these sins.”
verses.6: And when you eat and drink, remember that it is those foods and drinks that make you feel full.
verses.7: Let these words be fulfilled: “As the Lord commanded through the prophets from ancient times, when Jerusalem was still a city with walls and its surrounding towns. And the land was still under their rule.”
verses.8: And the words of Jehovah were given to Zechariah.
verses.9: So said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “Let them judge fairly, with justice and mercy. Let them treat each other with kindness.”
verses.10: And Alma and Yatom Ger, and the poor man – do not despise them. And do not consider your brother’s enemies as your friends.
verses.11: They were ordered to listen. They were given a piece of cloth to cover their ears.
verses.12: And their hearts set up guard over the Torah and over the words that Jehovah sent His angels by means of the earlier prophets. And there was great anger from Jehovah’s angels.
verses.13: And when they called, but did not hear; then they will call again, but I will not listen. Thus said the LORD, the God of hosts.
verses.14: And they will wander through all those nations who do not know them. The land will be left behind, and they will be forced to live in a land that is hot and dry.
